pet_notes: Use the standing breakdown as the primary design reference and the sitting plush photo only for face, soft toy proportions, paw-pad/star detail, and material cues. Create a 2D flat chibi puppy official merch/sticker-style desktop pet base illustration: cream body, round head, floppy ears, viewer-left cream ear with small rainbow stars, viewer-right lime yellow-green ear, brown dot eyes and brows, brown puppy mouth with pink tongue, short brown whisker-like cheek marks, small yellow star near cheek, subtle cheek blush only, light blue wing-like side shapes behind arms, green four-leaf flower emblem on chest with small black x. Do not include the yellow outer tracing outline from the standing breakdown. No clothing, no blue tag, no added stars beyond the ear/cheek markings from the design, no text, no watermark, no background pattern, no 3D, no plush-photo rendering.
